summary: Iteration 96 - Backend-only e2e of Partner API v1 Stripe hosted-Checkout for Sponsorships (trivia + rj_read) and Marketplace Promotions (Promoted-rail + Category Spotlight). New pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_iter96_partner_api_payments.py - 28/28 pass. Verified: (a) LIVE trivia/rj_read/promotion/spotlight all return real checkout.stripe.com URLs + cs_test_ session_ids; owning object flips to pending_payment; (b) trivia /submit correctly returns 409 use_checkout_endpoint; (c) rj_read /submit moves to pending_moderation; (d) marketplace catalog (tiers=3, categories>0, businesses list); (e) ownership scoping (unknown promotion_id -> 404 promotion_not_found); (f) error handling (bad_tier, business_not_found, bad_category, bid/amount out_of_range); (g) SANDBOX path: advertiser/trivia/promotion/spotlight all instantly active, sponsorship /checkout returns checkout_required:false; (h) auth: 401 without bearer, 401 with bad key, LIVE key has all scopes. Idempotent status polls verified for spotlight. The Stripe-hosted PAID->ACTIVE browser round-trip was attempted 3x via Playwright but the Stripe checkout UI now uses an accordion layout in 'Sandbox' mode and the Card accordion click resolved 'outside of viewport'; API-side proof of URL generation + state transitions is complete. Backend logs clean; supervisor OK.

minor.issue: Ownership filter is by partner_id only (not by environment). LIVE and SANDBOX keys of the same partner therefore share visibility. Consider adding an environment scope on the query so a SANDBOX key cannot poll a LIVE promotion. Not exploitable across partners.

action_items: OPTIONAL manual verification: open the trivia checkout URL that was returned in this run (see updated_files test file - a fresh URL is generated per POST /sponsorships/{id}/checkout), pay with 4242 4242 4242 4242 in a real browser, then GET /sponsorships/{id}/checkout/status?type=trivia&advertiser_id=... to observe paid:true and status='active' (or 'pending_admin' if total >= $500). Same for promotion (expected status=pending_review post-payment) and spotlight (expected status=credited, budget_cents credited).
OPTIONAL: consider tightening marketplace_promotions ownership filter to include partner + environment (currently only partner_id).
OPTIONAL: normalize environment casing in /me and create_advertiser responses (currently 'LIVE'/'SANDBOX' uppercase from Caller model). Tests handle both cases but PRD wording used lowercase.
critical_code_review_comments: partner_api_v1.sponsorship_checkout correctly routes trivia -> tr.create_checkout and rj_read -> rj.create_checkout with a Stripe hosted mode. Sandbox path short-circuits with checkout_required:false as documented.

partner_marketplace.promotion_checkout: sandbox writes a status=active row with paid:true and applies the tier immediately via _apply_active (single source of truth reused from routes.marketplace_promotions). Good.
partner_marketplace.spotlight_status is properly idempotent - if a topup is already 'credited', it returns the current budget without re-crediting. Verified by double-polling.
Trivia submit guard (409 use_checkout_endpoint) is enforced at the route layer for LIVE (correctly bypassed for sandbox which is a no-op success).
All create_checkout endpoints propagate ValueError('stripe_unconfigured') via _map_error(400); STRIPE_MODE=live with a sk_test_ Stripe key produces real cs_test_ Checkout Sessions as expected.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Partner API v1 hosted-Checkout paths are fully verified up to the Stripe redirect. New regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iter96_partner_api_payments.py (28 tests). The only remaining un-mechanized verification is the actual Stripe UI card entry + redirect to BIGFM_PUBLIC_BASE_URL/payment/success - Playwright against checkout.stripe.com is finicky under this env because Stripe now renders an accordion 'Sandbox' UI. If needed, main agent (or a human) can open the returned checkout_url in a real browser, pay with 4242, and then poll /api/v1/sponsorships/{id}/checkout/status (or /marketplace/promotion/{id}/status, /marketplace/spotlight/{session_id}/status) to confirm paid:true + activated. For rj_read, ELEVENLABS_API_KEY IS SET in /app/backend/.env (contrary to the problem statement which said empty) - so post-payment TTS render should actually succeed, not gracefully fail with tts_render_failed. If the review-request assumption was that ELEVENLABS is empty, please double-check.
rca of the issue: N/A - no defects. One MINOR observation: marketplace promotion_status ownership scoping filters by partner_id only; because a partner has both a LIVE and a SANDBOX credential, a SANDBOX key can poll a LIVE promotion of the same partner. Cross-partner isolation is intact.
